title: Glossy block tumble with camera push-in
summary: Five glossy rounded primitives on a dark gradient floor: a block tumbles in from the right, bumps the hero cube and settles, then the camera springs in to a low close-up and holds. A brand-colour toy moment with no copy.
use_when: A short abstract brand sting built from the brand palette as physical objects
An intro or bumper before a title card, where weight and contact read as playful
Social loops or teasers that need motion without any copy or UI

sfx.event: green block lands and bumps the hero cube (~1.00-1.27 s)
camera springs in to the close-up (2.00-2.50 s)

structure.shot: hero blue rounded cube centre-left, small pink and orange rounded cubes resting behind it, dark gradient floor, no copy
structure.camera: slow pull back: cube width ~90 -> ~75 px per cell over 15 fr (motion.json -4.5 %/s zoom in second 0)
structure.motion: small objects shift a few px as the frame drifts; nothing enters yet (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a red sphere riding a long green rounded block tumbles in from frame right, lands tilted, slides into the blue cube, rebounds and settles beside it
structure.camera: drift: framing pans slightly left (-14 px/s @1920) while the scene recentres on the pair
structure.motion: physics: green block enters f15 rotated ~30 deg, lands f30, contacts the cube f38, rebounds and settles by f53 (±0.25 s); blue cube tips slightly from the hit by f60; red sphere stays on top; settle reads as springs.heavy (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: low close-up: the blue cube and green block fill the lower frame edges, the three small primitives line up along the top of the gap
structure.camera: push-in ~1.0 -> ~2.2 (cube width ~90 -> ~200 px per cell) f60-f75, settled by f75; static hold f83-f100
structure.motion: camera on springs.cameraIn ~15 fr (overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s); objects at rest; last two cells identical

params.brand: any brand.json: object colours from accent, fg and muted; bg for the floor gradient
params.objects: list of primitives {shape: cube|slab|sphere, colour, size}; default 2 hero cubes/slabs + 3 small pieces
params.timing.dropAt: frame the tumbling block enters (default 15 at 30 fps)
params.seed: physics seed so the tumble is deterministic

notes: One continuous shot, 0 cuts (cuts.json). Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. All times from the 4 fps sheet (±0.25 s); spring names are defaults (no 30 fps strip). Palette from palettegen on keyframes; pink (~#E0B0C8), orange (~#E08000) and red (~#E00000) pieces were too small for palettegen and are eyeballed, recipe.md only. The studio has no R3F/physics scene component: missing PhysicsPrimitives (see recipe.md). The catalogue hint device-3d does not apply: no device is shown.
